# Recorded AI answers

Real answers from the check models (`gpt-4.1-mini`, `claude-haiku-4-5`, `sonar`), saved so tests and `is_test` agencies run full scans with no AI cost (D-61).

- Filled in B-31: about 50 answers per model for 3 industries in 2 cities.
- One JSON file per answer, chosen at run time by question and model.
- Public business names only. No customer data, no private questions.
